Experiencing Tokyo in HCMC
Feb 2019 • Family
There are many different sushi restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City but I have never tasted anything more special and fresh than in Tokyo Deli. My Mom, my little brother and I were going on a walk to Crescent mall, which is a popular mall in district 7, Ho Chi Minh City. A few hours later, which was soon lunchtime, we decided to go to Tokyo Deli that was located on the Crescent Residence 1, which is near Crescent mall, Tân Phú, District 7, Hồ Chí Minh City.

When we first arrived and stepped inside the restaurant, it brought me thoughts of my mother telling us of how she felt going inside a sushi restaurant when she was in Tokyo (Japan) because as soon as I stepped in, in my mind I was saying WOW! And felt the same way as my mother’s feelings. We were also sweating since we walked through the street of Crescent mall for several hours but luckily, the restaurant was well airconditioned so we didn’t have any problems dealing with heat. Overall, the inside of Tokyo Deli made me feel like I was in Japan! The tables and the seats were well cleaned and I felt it was different from other sushi restaurants that are in Vietnam because most of the seats weren’t clean when I went to most of them. 

We ordered the Sushi combination, Oyster dish, shrimp cutlet with rice, and grilled salmon with teriyaki sauce. The dishes were very well presented as you can see in the photos below and the seafood used on the sushi itself looked very fresh. I ordered the grilled salmon with teriyaki sauce as told above and surely enough, it was very appetizing. The grizzling sound of the soft salmon made me starve to death. It was cooked perfectly as if there was a Japanese professional cooker there. There were french fries, onions, carrots, and corn that added to the taste of excellence. Further on, when we ordered one more plate of the oyster meal, we got two FREEBIES! We got two more oysters than the plate before we ordered the second one.

Most of the food we ordered came on a reliable time (in about ten minutes) and a glass of cold tea was served before we got our food. The staff person that was taking the order was really polite, friendly and accommodating. He was able to take the right orders that we gave him and the way they didn’t make a fuss when we asked them to bring one more small cup of teriyaki sauce for the salmon dish made me feel very satisfied with this place. When the food came, most of them were very well served such as the oyster dish because there were lots of decorations that made the food look like it was imported straight from Japan. What I thought was most creative among all of the decoration was the small pot decoration, that was placed in the oyster dish, with dry ice because it made a very cool effect as you can see on the picture. This brought up my satisfaction with a dish to 100%. 

There were lots of reviews that have stated, “good food but terrible service” or “below average sushi”. According to what I experienced, I strongly disagree with these reviews because as a person who has eaten Japanese sushi for a long time, I honestly think the service was above exceptional and I totally think the sushi there tasted just like the sushi I’ve tasted in Japan.

The negative sides were that when we came, some of the menus ran out and we weren’t able to order them but I have noticed that it only happens when they have loads of customers. Other than that, I wouldn’t consider Tokyo Deli being a problematic restaurant.
In my opinion, I don’t think the meal is overpriced at all and I think it was a fair price for these kinds of meal. The salmon with teriyaki sauce and a bowl of rice cost a total of 95,000VND and I think it is a reliable cost for this appetizing dish. As stated above, as a person who has eaten a fair amount of Japanese food, I highly recommend you trying the salmon grill with teriyaki sauce, the sushi combination menu, and the oyster dish! 

In conclusion, I had a very amicable experience in Tokyo Deli since I was able to have exceptional family time and have an impressive meal for lunch. I surely and positively agree that this restaurant is worth the money and your precious time. I will positively and assuredly come back to Tokyo Deli in the future for this money worthy and delicious menus. It would be a fantastic lunch that will brighten up your afternoon. Don’t you want to experience something new and experience Tokyo in Ho Chi Minh City? Well, then GO for it!😁
